job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, and deploy AI-powered solutions using machine learning algorithms to solve complex business problems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas where AI can add value and implement data-driven decision making processes.
Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines using Python, SQL, and other tools to support analytics initiatives.
Stay up-to-date with emerging trends in generative AI and deep learning to drive innovation in the organization.

Job Requirements :

6-10 years of experience in IT services & consulting industry as an Artificial Intelligence Engineer or similar role.
Strong analytical skills with expertise in developing predictive models using machine learning techniques.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, SQL, and familiarity with cloud-based platforms like AWS/Azure/GCP.
